t.eng-ummmuhammad: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest

ayahs.arabic: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waraayta alnnasa yadkhuloona fee deeni Allahi afwajan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes

ayahs.arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
ayahs.translit: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika waistaghfirhu innahu kana tawwaban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance
